body:
Two changes to the board's toasts.

1. When more than 5 toasts are showing, show a "Close All" button that dismisses every toast. Hide it at 5 or fewer.
2. A toast must not show the text of the question or note that triggered it. Show only the heading (for example "Question on <title>" or "Reply on <title>") and the existing buttons, so "Show task" still opens the task on the right tab.

Update the board tests for both changes and rebuild the bundle.
title: Toasts: Close All button and no question or note text
